findings.issue: Recipe view model/loader omits skillLevel, batch quantity, visibility/review state, activeWorkHours, consumed flags in its declared component interface, formula access and candidate operational fields. Current output cannot certify reviewed framework parity.
Material extraction deduplicates by drop name alone; reviewed material identity requires source occurrence/tier/properties/role/form and unit mass/value.
Library rarity and weight are randomly generated from bestiary tier slots on mount instead of using authoritative material records; identity/mass can change between sessions.

Custom experiment invents DC/time randomly and output from average tier/value/properties without formula/training/time/inventory rules; treat as legacy ideation, not execution of new reviewed crafting.
Displayed resultItem.value has no explicit batch-vs-unit interpretation; source quantity is absent from view model.
